// CASE dart_chunk_canonical_comment expect=pass
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(
      await Future.wait(group.map(/* don't "await" each */ operation)),
    );
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE dart_chunk_interp_extra expect=fire
Future<List<R>> b<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(
      log(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)), '${await flush(offset)}'),
    );
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE dart_chunk_awaited_items_header expect=fire
Future<List<R>> c<T, R>(
  Future<List<T>> Function() source,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < (await source()).length; offset += width) {
    final group = (await source()).skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE dart_chunk_awaited_width expect=fire
Future<List<R>> d<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  Future<int> Function() width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += await width()) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(await width());
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE dart_chunk_formatted expect=pass
Future<List<R>> e<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}
